mapper.select: SELECT USERID, USERNAME, RESPONSIBLE, USERPOSITION, "E-MMAIL" AS eMmail FROM hdoc_user_infor WHERE USERID = #{userid} OR USERNAME = #{username}
SELECT `FUNCTION`, USERID FROM HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH WHERE USERID = #{userid}
SELECT USERID, MARKET, `TYPE`, BU FROM HDOC_MARKET_AUTH WHERE USERID = #{userid} AND `TYPE` IN ( SELECT `FUNCTION` FROM HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH WHERE USERID = #{userid} )
mapper.update: UPDATE HDOC_MARKET_AUTH SET USERID = #{userid}, MARKET = #{market}, `TYPE` = #{type}, BU = #{bu}, UPDATE_DATETIME = SYSDATE(), UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser}, UPDATE_PROCESS = #{updateProcess} WHERE USERID = #{userid} AND MARKET = #{market} AND `TYPE` = #{type} AND BU = #{bu}

UPDATE HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH SET `FUNCTION` = #{function}, USERID = #{userid}, UPDATE_DATETIME = SYSDATE(), UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser}, UPDATE_PROCESS = #{updateProcess} WHERE `FUNCTION` = #{function} AND USERID = #{userid}
